name: laglingo
description: Windows-first local delayed live player with real-time ASR and translated subtitles.

scripts.check:js: node --check extension/src/adapters.js && node --check extension/src/content.js && node --check extension/src/metrics.js && node --check prototype/hls-companion/extension/service-worker.js && node --check prototype/hls-companion/web-player/ui-bootstrap.js && node --check prototype/hls-companion/web-player/player.js && node --check prototype/hls-companion/web-player/language-selector.js && node --check prototype/hls-companion/web-player/subtitle-scheduler.js && node --check prototype/hls-companion/web-player/subtitle-window-controller.js && node --check prototype/hls-companion/web-player/media-clock.js && node --check prototype/hls-companion/web-player/poll-loop.js && node --check prototype/hls-companion/web-player/live-messages-client.js && node --check prototype/hls-companion/web-player/workbench-controller.js && node --check prototype/hls-companion/web-player/pane-resizer.js && node --check prototype/hls-companion/web-player/diagnostics-log.js && node --check prototype/hls-companion/web-player/playback-recovery.js
scripts.ci: npm run guard:release && npm run guard:tracked && npm run check:python && npm run check:js && npm run test:hls-companion && npm test
